Bill.BriefDescription: Prohibiting the release of barred owls.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to barred owls; adding a new section to chapter77.15 RCW; and prescribing penalties.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 77.15 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) It is unlawful for any private citizen or public employee torelease from captivity anywhere in the state a barred owl (Strix varia)or a barred owl/spotted owl hybrid (Strix occidentalis x Strix varia)that has been captured alive pursuant to the authority granted in afederal permit. (2) A violation of this section shall be punished as a naturalresource infraction under chapter 7.84 RCW.
